name: Capacity-Adjusted Revival
hypothesis: A previously rejected token that replenishes liquidity while short-term buying returns may outperform indiscriminate momentum; a size-specific cost gate can replace an arbitrary large liquidity floor for a $7 allocation.

replay.fees_case: PumpPortal Local + conservative ordinary-pool fee, assumed slippage/fixed/data costs
replay.unobserved_exit: Report as censored; additionally report an explicit zero-recovery stress case

limitations: No independent social-author or buyer-wallet information
Aggregator marks are not executable bids or swap simulations
Historical recorded sample times are not measured end-to-end decision receipt times
A selected follow-up-observability universe, not all launched or rejected tokens
Counterfactual mark replay cannot establish a captured account doubling or validate full SLR
